jobs.title: Citi Commerce, Product Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Citi is evolving its current commerce offerings and branching into new avenues of growth by offering merchants access to high value cardmembers across Citi's digital properties and partner placements. By combining Citi's scale, trusted customer relationships, and real purchase insights, the business delivers advertising that is relevant to customers and drives measurable, incremental impact for advertisers.
As the Product Manager, you will support the Product team in executing against Citi Commerce's product roadmap across a defined set of ad and offers capabilities. You will be deeply embedded in the build process, contributing to business requirements, partnering closely with technology teams, and ensuring every capability that ships meets commercial and technical standards.

Job Summary
The Product Manager is a key member of the Citi Commerce Product team, supporting the development and execution of Citi Commerce's ad and offers capabilities. Reporting to the Head of Product, this individual will contribute to the translation of business and commercial requirements into detailed technical specifications, serving as a day-to-day partner to technology teams as Citi Commerce builds its ad serving, targeting, and measurement capabilities.
This is a hands-on, high-impact role at the intersection of business and technology. The Product Manager will work closely with the Product Lead and broader product team, supporting business requirements documentation, assisting with third-party integrations, and ensuring every capability that ships meets commercial and technical standards.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the development and documentation of business requirements for Citi Commerce's ad and offers capabilities, translating commercial and advertiser needs into precise, technology-ready specifications
- Serve as a day-to-day partner to technology teams, driving alignment on requirements, managing trade-offs, and maintaining momentum through the product development lifecycle
- Support product testing and quality assurance, including UAT and performance validation, ensuring capabilities meet commercial and technical standards before launch
- Support the management of third-party integrations within the AdTech ecosystem, including DSPs, ad servers, and measurement platforms, coordinating with vendors on timelines and technical requirements
- Support governance and compliance approval processes, preparing documentation and tracking approvals through legal and risk review
- Support the tracking of the product and system performance post-launch, identifying issues and surfacing optimization recommendations to the Head of Product and Product Lead
- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency

Qualifications
Required
- 6-10 years of experience in product management within digital advertising, adtech, or martech
- Demonstrated experience contributing to the development of detailed business requirements and technical specifications, and partnering closely with technology teams through the product development lifecycle
- Solid understanding of the digital advertising technology stack, including ad serving, targeting, measurement, and delivery systems
- Experience supporting third-party technology integrations within the advertising ecosystem
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for business audiences and business requirements for technology teams
- Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

Preferred
- Experience in commerce media, retail media, or financial services advertising strongly preferred
- Background at a publisher, retail media network, DSP, SSP, or adtech platform
- Familiarity with clean rooms, identity solutions, or attribution platforms
- Exposure to launching a new ad product or capability from early stage through launch

Education
- Bachelor's/University degree required

jobs.title: Research Product Manager
jobs.description:
Citi is looking for a Research Product Manager at the Assistant Vice President level to join the EMEA Research Product Management team, playing a meaningful role in shaping the commercial strategy, client relevance, and market positioning of Citi's research franchise across Western Europe and CEEMEA.
Sitting at the intersection of Research, Sales and Trading, this role combines market insights, fundamental analytical skills, data-driven analysis, and commercial awareness to strengthen client engagement and grow franchise impact. Working closely with senior Research management, the successful candidate will help identify opportunities to enhance Citi's research offering, improve the visibility and consumption of research content, and support strategic initiatives that contribute to franchise growth.
The role is ideally suited to a finance professional with strong equity markets knowledge and fundamental research skills, potentially from a Sector Research, Equity Strategy, Institutional Sales, or related Markets background, who is looking to apply that expertise in a broader strategic and franchise management capacity.

Responsibilities

- Support the execution of the EMEA Research product strategy by identifying opportunities to enhance the commercial impact and market positioning of Citi Research across the region.
- Build and maintain franchise analytics covering pipeline tracking, market share analysis, thematic and event look-back reviews, client engagement metrics, and competitive benchmarking to inform strategic priorities.
- Analyse business and client data to produce actionable insights that guide content strategy, franchise decisions, and senior management reporting.
- Partner with sector analysts, equity strategists and product management colleagues to identify key investment themes, share best practices, and support initiatives that enhance the visibility, relevance and commercial impact of Citi's research.
- Develop high-quality pitch books, franchise presentations, and best-practice materials that articulate the breadth and value of Citi Research to internal and external audiences.
- Coordinate cross-sector and thematic research initiatives, bringing differentiated investment ideas to market through structured, well-managed delivery.
- Manage franchise communications including research podcasts, marketing campaigns, and cross-department publication efforts to maximise audience engagement.
- Monitor market developments, investor trends and client feedback to identify opportunities for content enhancement, innovation and franchise growth.
- Evaluate and support the adoption of new technologies, including AI-enabled tools, to improve research workflows, content delivery, and client engagement.
- Contribute to research commercialisation, distribution and client engagement initiatives designed to broaden franchise reach and increase business impact.
- Support senior Research management on strategic projects and broader business priorities.

Required Qualifications & Skills

- Experience working within financial services in a role such as Equity Research, Research Product Management, Institutional Sales, Equity Strategy, or a related Markets function.
- Solid grasp of equity markets and key macro themes, with the ability to translate market knowledge into commercially relevant insight.
- Strong fundamental analytical skills, including experience analysing companies, sectors, markets or investment themes.
- Track record of analysing business performance, client engagement metrics, and market trends to generate clear, actionable conclusions.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and coordinate across stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to diverse audiences.
- Analytical capability that combines quantitative rigour with sound commercial judgement.
- Collaborative working style with the ability to build effective relationships across functions and seniority levels.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

- Background as a Sector Analyst or in Equity Strategy, with an interest in transitioning into a broader strategic role within a research franchise.
- Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and their practical application within research, content management, or client engagement workflows.
- Experience coordinating thematic or cross-sector research initiatives and bringing investment ideas to market.
- Experience supporting research commercialisation, client engagement initiatives or content strategy within a research or markets environment.

What We Offer

This role offers the chance to work at the heart of one of the world's leading financial institutions, contributing to a high-profile research franchise with genuine regional scope and commercial significance. You will collaborate closely with senior research leadership and cross-functional teams, with real ownership over strategic projects that shape how Citi Research is positioned and delivered across EMEA.
- Opportunities to grow your career locally and collaborate with colleagues across Citi's global network.
- A hybrid working model that balances in-office collaboration with remote flexibility.
- Investment in your professional development through training programmes, mentorship, and skill-building opportunities.
- Employee wellbeing support including medical coverage, mental health resources, parental leave, and family support programmes.
- Competitive retirement contributions and investment options to support your long-term financial goals.

Apply now to bring your equity markets expertise to a strategic role that shapes the future of Citi's research franchise across EMEA.
Additional Job Description

Candidates applying for this role must be aware that it is a Certified Role, subject to the FCA and PRA Certification Regime.

The Certification Regime is one element of the Individual Accountability Regime which came into effect on 7 March 2016.

Under the Certification Regime, Citi UK regulated entities (Citi entities) must ensure that employees working in certain roles categorised as specified significant harm functions (Certified Roles) are assessed as fit and proper to carry out their role.

Under the guidance provided by the FCA and PRA, firms should have regard to the following when assessing fitness and propriety:

• Honesty, integrity and reputation

• Financial soundness

• Competence and capability

In order to comply with the requirements of the Certification Regime, Citi entities must take reasonable care to ensure that an employee does not perform a Certified Role without first being certified as Fit and Proper. For this reason, you will be assessed for this role against the Fit and Proper requirements, as described above.

This assessment will be carried out through extensive interviews, self-disclosures, permitted criminal record checks, regulated reference checks, credit checks and other background screening checks

jobs.title: Custody Product Manager (Senior Vice President)
jobs.description:
Team/Role Overview
The Product Management Group Manager is a senior management level position responsible for managing a broad range of Product Management employees, setting strategy and providing direction, leadership and budgetary management, etc. Additionally, this role will be responsible for the development of product plans, strategies, and tactics while coordinating product lines through product life-cycles in coordination with the broader Product Management team. The overall objective of this role is to coordinate the promotion of products to develop new markets, increase share of market and obtain competitive position.

This Role is a “Controlled Function” Role as defined by the Central Bank of Ireland Reform Act 2010 and Principal Regulations 2011, and amending Regulations 2014, 2015.

What you’ll do:
- Provide strategic direction and accountability for the full European Custody franchise across the Single Legal Vehicle. Act as the primary product representative for Citibank Europe Plc at senior governance forums, regulatory interactions, and client engagements.
- Hold full product ownershi p for Citi Ireland incorporating the Single Legal Vehicle across 11 European markets, ensuring product coherence, commercial integrity, and regulatory compliance. Maintain the Citibank Europe Plc booking model product catalogue for Custody, ensuring accuracy and alignment with the firm's legal entity and product strategy.
- AI-Driven Product Efficiency & Innovation:
Proactively identify, evaluate, prioritize, and implement Artificial Intelligence (AI) opportunities within product development, market strategy, and operational processes. The overarching goal is to minimise manual product efforts, enabling teams to concentrate on core strategic initiatives that deliver tangible value for Citi and its clients. Actively seek AI synergies across:
    Product development workflows and documentation.
    Client reporting and service delivery.
    Root cause analysis and operational issue resolution.
    Competitive intelligence and business development support.
- Business Growth & AI Integration. Drive and support new business growth across the European Custody franchise, providing product support for business development activities including competitor intelligence, RFIs, RFPs, roadshows, and due diligence. Actively seek and apply AI tools and intelligence to streamline these processes, enhancing efficiency and quality of output. Identify and support sales opportunities — including take-away campaigns and domestic client opportunities — and manage client implementations and onboardings.
- Cluster Financial Management. Own and manage financial performance across the European Custody product portfolio. Report monthly performance against plan, driving accountability for P&L, cost management, revenue tracking, and efficiency opportunities including allocation saves. This requires a deep understanding of financial principles, proactive engagement with financial departments, and the creation of insightful management reports to identify and lead revenue and expense initiatives.
- DORA Management & Central Bank of Ireland Engagement. Manage the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) requirements for the Custody product function with direct engagement with the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI), ensuring full compliance and readiness across all applicable Custody activities.
- Operational Resilience. Lead operational resilience strategy and execution for Custody across Europe, ensuring robust frameworks to maintain critical service continuity and meet regulatory expectations across all 11 CEP markets.
- Risk Event Coordination — IBRC. Coordinate all risk events with the Internal Business Risk Committee (IBRC) across Europe, acting as the primary product liaison to ensure timely escalation, documentation, and resolution.
- Product Owner — Remediation, Issues & CAP Management. Drive remediation efforts across European Custody as product owner, including management of open issues and Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) through to full resolution.

Represent Citi in market meetings and industry working groups, actively engaging with digital and AI initiatives to influence market harmonisation and the adoption of agreed regional/global standards.

- Tech & Ops Principal Point of Contact — CSC. Serve as the primary product coordination point and principal contact for Technology and Operations in the Custody Service Centre (CSC), ensuring alignment between product requirements and operational delivery.
- Client Asset Lead — Product. Serve as the product lead for Client Assets across Europe, ensuring compliance with client asset protection frameworks and regulatory obligations, and maintaining robust governance processes.

jobs.description:
Citi Markets operates at the heart of global capital markets, providing liquidity, risk management, and financing solutions to institutional clients worldwide. Our operation is uniquely global. Within our Prime Brokerage and Securities Financing division, we serve the world's most sophisticated hedge funds, asset managers, and institutional investors. Our platform supports a comprehensive suite of services including cash and synthetic prime brokerage, securities lending and borrowing, repo financing, margin optimization, and cross-asset clearing.

The Product Manager – Financing & Clearing is a high-impact leadership position accountable for driving revenue growth, strategic platform innovation, and risk excellence across Citi's financing and clearing infrastructure. This role sits at the critical intersection of front-office sales and trading, quantitative risk management, client service, and global technology delivery.

At Citi Markets, we win together. In a rapidly changing world, our shared vision gives us the clarity, agility, and global perspectives we need to shape the future. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the strategic direction of a globally significant platform, build deep client relationships across the institutional investor community, and lead cross-functional initiatives that directly enhance business profitability and competitive positioning.

Primary Responsibilities

- Own Platform Innovation and Capability Development: Help define and prioritize the multi-year platform roadmap for cash prime brokerage, synthetic equities, securities lending, stock locate. Lead large-scale, cross-functional initiatives to deliver state-of-the-art functionality—real-time margin analytics, automated collateral optimization, API connectivity, and digital client portals—that unlock new trading opportunities and improve operational efficiency.
- Serve as the Strategic Liaison Across Business, Technology, and Operations: Scope complex technical requirements, lead agile delivery teams, and drive execution of significant platform enhancements in partnership with global technology and operations functions. Act as the primary decision-maker and escalation point for key stakeholders including Legal, Compliance, Risk, Middle Office, and senior trading desk leadership.

Proactively shape business positioning and product development to address material regulatory developments and competitive market dynamics.

Oversee operations and technology partners to ensure flawless execution of critical functions including trade lifecycle management, margin calculations, securities settlement, and corporate actions processing. Lead coordination with in-business Risk and Credit teams on complex client activity, driving policy formulation and strategic risk decisions.

Translate complex client requirements into actionable product enhancements that deliver measurable business value and strengthen client retention.

- Define & Own the Product Vision: Formulate and articulate a compelling multi-year product vision and roadmap for Controls Technology platforms aligned with global enterprise risk appetite, regulatory mandates, and business objectives.

- Architecture & Engineering Partnership: Collaborate with Enterprise Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure platform scalability, data integrity, microservice modularity, and high-availability standards.

- Identify and implement automation opportunities for repetitive tasks such as audit evidence collection and status report generation, reducing manual effort and improving the speed and accuracy of compliance activities.

- At least 2 years of IT experience overall, with a minimum of 3 years in an Application Development, Production Support, or DevOps environment, demonstrating hands-on familiarity with how applications are built, maintained, and governed.

- Working knowledge of IT Service Management platforms such as ServiceNow, or experience with low-code automation tools used to streamline operational and compliance workflows.

Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.

The Role:
Citi is seeking a seasoned Cybersecurity Product Manager ( AI & Security Ops )   to own the end-to-end product management and enterprise delivery of major security operations platforms across a complex, multi-stakeholder environment. This is a senior-level, high-impact role requiring a rare and deliberate combination of hands-on cybersecurity operations experience, enterprise product management discipline, vendor governance expertise, and applied fluency in Artificial Intelligence (AI) as it relates to security operations. The successful candidate will apply that practitioner credibility to translate competing stakeholder needs into structured roadmaps, user stories, and platform/product delivery outcomes. They will serve as the authoritative customer voice for the assigned products while holding vendors to rigorous contractual and performance standards. This role sits at the intersection of cybersecurity operations, security engineering, and responsible AI enablement, and is central to the future of Citi's security operations capabilities.

The Ideal Candidate:
The ideal candidate has spent meaningful time on the operational front lines of cybersecurity operations and has subsequently moved into product or program management roles where they translate that practitioner knowledge into platform strategy and delivery. They have run or held an authoritative position in engineering and SDLC processes, running agile/scrum teams. They understand the needs of both operations and engineering and have proven experience managing vendors to ensure those needs are met.

Critically, the ideal candidate approaches product capabilities, particularly leveraging AI, with informed skepticism and strategic clarity. They understand that AI can meaningfully accelerate detection, triage, and response, but also that a poorly validated model can generate alert fatigue, erode analyst trust, and introduce new risks. They can distinguish genuine capabilities from vendor marketing, ask the right questions about security capabilities and ensure that AI-driven features empower operational teams rather than undermine them. They bring both credibility with operational teams and the organizational influence to drive a complex, multi-stakeholder product agenda that responsibly integrates AI into the future of security operations.

Responsibilities
- Own and drive the end-to-end product roadmap for one or more major security operations platforms, balancing requirements from 10+ distinct internal customer groups including SOC, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, Insider Threat, Vulnerability Management, IT Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Business units.
- Develop and maintain a clearly prioritized product backlog, facilitate structured intake and prioritization processes, and define and track product OKRs, KPIs, and success metrics — including AI-specific performance indicators such as detection accuracy, false positive rates, and model drift.
- Apply first-hand cybersecurity operations expertise to translate analyst needs into high-quality product artifacts including user stories, user journeys, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications — including workflows augmented by AI-assisted tooling.
- Identify, document, and translate AI use cases into actionable product requirements, addressing operational pain points such as alert triage automation, anomaly detection, natural language threat querying, and AI-assisted investigation.
- Evaluate vendor-provided capabilities critically, assessing maturity, suitability, and growth potential. Require documented evidence of model validation, performance benchmarks, and drift management processes.
- Serve as the primary product-level point of accountability for vendor relationships, leading governance forums, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and escalation proceedings while enforcing SLA compliance and contractual obligations.
- Collaborate with Citi's AI/ML, Data Science, and Enterprise AI Governance teams to ensure AI features embedded in Security Operations products comply with internal policies, model risk management requirements, and applicable regulatory guidance.
- Serve as Product Owner in Agile/Scrum ceremonies across one or more concurrent delivery workstreams, partnering with program managers, development teams, and platform architects to deliver roadmap initiatives on schedule and within scope.
- Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) across multiple customer groups, ensuring quality gates and AI feature output benchmarks are met prior to production releases.
- Drive platform adoption across customer groups through structured change management, onboarding guides, and enablement sessions. Champion practitioner-centered design and appropriate human oversight of AI-driven workflows in all product decisions.
- Present platform health, roadmap status, and AI feature performance to senior cybersecurity leadership and technology executives on a recurring cadence.

Qualifications
- 6+ years' combined professional experience across all four of the following domains, with demonstrated experience in each: enterprise product and project management with roadmap ownership and vendor accountability; cybersecurity engineering with hands-on platform design or integration; cybersecurity operations including SOC analysis, incident response, threat hunting, or insider threat investigation; and AI enablement from concept through deployment.
- Demonstrated working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts applied to cybersecurity, including behavioral analytics, anomaly detection, LLM-based security tooling, and SOAR or agentic AI automation.
- Proven ability to critically evaluate vendor AI product claims, enforce appropriate testing and acceptance standards, and manage escalation and contractual accountability.
- Demonstrated expertise translating operational and technical cybersecurity requirements into structured product artifacts including user stories, user journeys, acceptance criteria, and multi-quarter roadmaps.
- Strong executive communication skills, written and verbal, with the ability to present complex technical, AI, and product topics clearly to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience functioning as a Product Owner or equivalent role on Agile/Scrum delivery teams.
- Experience evaluating or deploying AI-native security products including AI-powered SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, NDR, or EDR platforms, or LLM-based security tooling.
- Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, SR 11-7), cybersecurity frameworks (NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK), and experience in regulated environments subject to SOX, FFIEC, OCC, or GDPR is preferred.
- Experience at a major financial institution or equivalent regulated enterprise is preferred.

Education
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Business Administration, related field or equivalent experience.
- Master's degree preferred.
- Product management certifications such as PMP, SAFe POPM, or CSPO are preferred.
- Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or GIAC (GCIA, GCIH, GDAT) are preferred.

- Derivative and collateral risk monitoring fluency

jobs.title: Head of Product and Engineering - Director
jobs.description:
Director (C15) - Head of Product and Engineering
Location: Pune (Hybrid)
Line of Business: Compliance Technology / Enterprise Technology

About the Role
Are you a product engineering leader who excels at driving massive platform consolidations, leading high-performing global teams, and solving complex distributed systems challenges? Do you believe in solving complex problem through technology simplification and modernisation?
At Citi, we are executing a bold, multi-year technology modernisation strategy. A critical pillar of this transformation is the unification of our global compliance enterprise workflow and case management systems. As the Head of Product and Engineering , you will be the strategic engineering leader and product visionary responsible for driving the consolidation, modernisation, and scaling of our global compliance case management platforms.
In this dual-hatted role, you will:
Lead Global Case Management & Workflow Platforms: Direct a globally distributed engineering organisation tasked with building and scaling our unified, high-throughput enterprise workflow and decisioning platforms.
Serve as the India Site Lead: Act as the senior technology executive for our regional engineering hub in India, driving talent strategy, engineering culture, and operational excellence across the site.
This is a high-visibility, executive-level role reporting directly to the Managing Director, Global Head of Product and Engineering.

Key Responsibilities
1. Technical Strategy ,Platform Unification and Product Management
- Drive Platform Consolidation: Define and execute the technical strategy to consolidate disparate legacy workflow and case management systems into a single, modern, global platform.
- Architectural Modernization: Lead the transition of core platforms to a cloud-native, microservices-based, and event-driven architecture capable of processing millions of complex events daily with sub-second latency.
- AI & Automation Integration: Partner with AI/ML research teams to embed intelligent routing, automated document processing, and machine learning-driven decision support systems into the core workflow engine.
- Technical Governance: Establish and enforce robust architectural standards, API designs, and data schemas that ensure long-term platform extensibility and maintainability.
- Product leadership: Thought leader and ability to wear the product hat. Ability to drive strategic product decision along with key stakeholders

2. Global Engineering Leadership & Execution
- Manage Globally Distributed Teams: Lead, inspire, and scale a multi-disciplinary engineering organization(75+)
- Foster Engineering Excellence: Establish rigorous standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability (monitoring, tracing, logging) to ensure 99.999% platform availability.
- Operational & Financial Management: Oversee financial planning, resource allocation, vendor management, and operational budgets for your global engineering organisation.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Operations, Risk, and senior business executives to align engineering roadmaps with business outcomes.

3. India Site Leadership
- Site Strategy & Growth: Act as the senior executive and site lead for the regional engineering hub in India. Drive local talent acquisition, retention, and career development programs.
- Culture & Collaboration: Build a vibrant, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture that mirrors the best practices of top-tier product technology companies.
- Local Governance: Ensure compliance with local regulations, operational standards, and corporate policies.

Our Target Tech Stack & Architecture
We are actively migrating our platforms to a modern, cloud-native stack:
- Backend & Microservices: Go, Java (Spring Boot), Python, gRPC, REST APIs
- Frontend & Workflows: React, Angular, TypeScript, Modern BPMN/Workflow Engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda, Flowable)
- Data & Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, AWS, Service Mesh (Istio)
- AI/ML & Analytics: Multi-LLM integrations via secure internal gateways, Vector Databases, Python-based ML pipelines

What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)
Basic Qualifications:
- Experience: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 5+ years in an engineering leadership role (Director, Senior Engineering Manager, or equivalent) at Product-Engineering first setup
-   Platform Unification: Proven track record of successfully leading large-scale platform consolidations, legacy migrations, or enterprise-wide system unifications.
- Distributed Systems: Deep expertise in designing and operating high-availability, low-latency, and highly secure distributed systems at massive scale.
- Global Leadership: Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams of 80+ engineers, including direct management of engineering managers and principal architects.
- Site Leadership: Proven experience leading a regional engineering site or hub, with a strong track record of building local talent pipelines and fostering a strong engineering culture.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Domain Knowledge: Experience in compliance, sanctions, transaction risk, anti-money laundering (AML), fraud detection, or high-scale transactional risk systems is highly desirable but not mandatory. We value core engineering leadership and platform-building capabilities above specific domain experience.
- Workflow & BPMN Expertise: Familiarity with modern workflow orchestration engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda) and complex state-machine design.
- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

Why Join Citi?
- Unprecedented Scale & Impact: We secure and facilitate the global financial system. The platforms you unify will protect trillions of dollars in daily transactions from financial crime and regulatory risk.
- True Autonomy: You will have the mandate, budget, and executive backing to make critical architectural and organizational decisions to achieve our platform unification goals.
- Modern Developer Ecosystem: Leverage Citi's state-of-the-art internal developer platforms, including our secure GenAI gateway and modern serverless application frameworks, to accelerate delivery.

And many more reasons…

You will be empowered to translate intricate requirements for risk and control systems into a flawlessly managed backlog of epics and user stories. Your primary mission is to drive the delivery of high-quality, compliant software by ensuring our development teams have the clarity and context needed to execute effectively, sprint after sprint. This is a role for a product owner — someone who thrives on execution, champions quality, and is passionate about building world-class technology solutions in a dynamic, global financial environment.

What You'll Do
1. Backlog Ownership & Agile Execution
- Own and Master the Backlog: Meticulously create, refine, and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring it is transparent, well-understood, and always ready for at least two sprints ahead.
- Translate Vision into Action: Deconstruct complex business requirements into well-defined Epics, User Stories, and precise Acceptance Criteria, ensuring a high percentage of stories are accepted without rework.
- Drive Sprint Success: Serve as the dedicated point of contact for the engineering team, providing unwavering clarity during sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and throughout the development cycle to remove ambiguity.

2. Solution Definition & Quality Assurance
- Define the "What": Partner with business stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document requirements, defining the precise solution to be built.
- Champion Quality: Drive a quality-first mindset with a relentless focus on clear, testable acceptance criteria to minimize ambiguity and reduce critical defects in UAT.

- Track Performance:  Track and report product performance post-launch to evaluate outcomes and support decisions around future investment.

3. Stakeholder Collaboration & Domain Leadership
- Build Partnerships: Act as the key liaison between business users, engineering teams, UX and other technology partners, fostering a collaborative environment to ensure seamless delivery; seeking continuous input from stakeholders and incorporating it into the backlog.
- Become the SME: Develop a deep expertise in your assigned Controls Technology modules, becoming the recognized go-to subject matter expert for the team and key stakeholders.
- Facilitate with Purpose: Lead and actively contribute to all agile ceremonies, ensuring refinement and planning sessions are efficient, productive, and outcome focused.
- Dependency & Risk Management:  Identify and manage cross-team and cross-platform dependencies early in the delivery lifecycle. Proactively highlight delivery risks, data dependencies, and integration challenges, and work with stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
- Communicate Clearly:  Communicate priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery status clearly to stakeholders and leadership. Support informed decision-making by articulating trade-offs and impacts across teams and timelines.

4. Innovation in Execution
